calculation_handling.description: Despite Chapter 200, no parking space is required in the R zone where access to a side- or rear-yard parking space cannot be provided from a lane or flanking street, the lot frontage is 7.6 m or less, the deed was registered on or before July 2, 1996, and a detached or semi-detached house or houseplex, or one townhouse unit, is erected after July 2, 1996.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces the Chapter 200 parking space requirement. The no-lane/no-flanking-street access condition is a negated token test the grammar cannot express, and the deed registration date is data we do not hold.

units.disclosure: Narrow lots (7.6 m or less) with no lane or flanking-street access and a deed registered by July 2, 1996 may need no parking; we cannot confirm the deed date or access.

calculation_handling.description: Despite Chapter 200, no parking space is required where access cannot be provided from a lane or flanking street and a lot not previously severed is severed into at most three lots, each with at most one dwelling unit and a lot frontage of 7.6 m or less.
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires severance history and the no-lane/no-flanking-street access test, neither of which we hold or can express.

units.disclosure: Lots created by a first severance into up to three narrow single-unit lots may need no parking; we cannot confirm severance history.

10.10.80.200(1).explanation: On narrow R-zone lots (7.6 m frontage or less) where parking cannot be reached from a lane or side street, no parking space is required if the lot dates from 1996 or earlier, or was created by a first severance into up to three single-unit lots. We do not evaluate this.
